outs.note: The show said Williams is probably out for the entire season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear and will not need surgery. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Jaylin Williams missed his fourth straight game Tuesday with back spasms.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
CJ McCollum has a calf injury that the show said will keep him out for about a month. He had moved into the starting lineup on 11/15 while Kingston Flemings was out.
Kingston Flemings is out with a lumbar strain, so Atlanta is without both McCollum and Flemings at guard. The show said Atlanta does not really have a point guard right now.

Asa Newell had surgery on Tuesday for a torn plantar plate in his left big toe and will be re-evaluated in about four months, per the Hawks. He has not played since November 4 and was a 10-to-19-minute bench forward before that, so Atlanta's rotation does not change much.
The show said Evan Mobley is out again on Wednesday. He has not appeared in the box scores since 11/11.
The show said Jaylon Tyson is doubtful for Wednesday. He did not play on 11/16 after starting and playing 34 minutes on 11/14.

The show said Jaylen Brown is out for the 11/18 slate. Brown had scored 31 points in each of his last two games, and the show expects Dean Wade, Anfernee Simons and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope to pick up more minutes. The show likes Simons and Tyrese Maxey in tournaments but called it a bad spot for Wade and VJ Edgecombe.
Trey Murphy III and Bennedict Mathurin both remained out for New Orleans on Monday.
The show said Ty Jerome is out again on Wednesday, the first night of a back-to-back, and it is possible Memphis is holding him out only for the first night. He also missed the 11/14 and 11/16 games.

injuries.text: Dylan Harper slipped on a wet spot with about 40 seconds left on Tuesday and strained his groin after playing 35 minutes. Mitch Johnson gave no timeline, but the show guessed it looks like a grade two strain and expects him out until around January. This is the show's guess, not a confirmed timeline.
